requirements_summary: POC focused on RAG over multi-source support KBs: Zendesk tickets, Confluence docs, nightly S3 exports, and a small SQL knowledge store. Requirements: (1) citation-first answers with source anchors and confidence scores; (2) freshness: near-real-time ingestion for high-severity tickets (<=1h); (3) multi-source rank fusion and deduplication; (4) bounded tail latency: p95<=400ms for agent-assist flows; (5) deterministic summarization for ticket threads (≤3-sentence TL;DR + action items); (6) tool-calling integrations: create/update ticket, escalate, attach KB refs; (7) cost sensitivity: prefer quantized open models for baseline with larger models for fallback; (8) fallback/routing: auto-fallback to cached canned replies or smaller model during spikes; (9) audit trail for every assistant response (trace id, cited doc ids)
